raw_text: Vishvas News investigation confirms that at least four widely shared images of the farmer protest crowds are AI-generated. Our pixel-level analysis found repeating texture patterns in crowd sections, anatomical impossibilities in hand and finger formations, and shadow angles that are physically impossible given the claimed time and location. The images appear to have been generated using a text-to-image model.
clean_text: Vishvas News confirms four farmer protest images are AI-generated. Repeating textures, anatomical impossibilities, and impossible shadow angles detected.
